caption: Sh. 6. Stela (Areika, Pl. 34, No. 5105)
labels: sic, by line 2 (over the 3-shaped sign of the last group before the divider at the left end of copy row 1)
blank, by line 6 (right end of copy row 5, before the first sign of line 6)
reading: wosi : soreyi : qo : qore(2)qoyl?qosi : i?edo : tebke(3)te?mye : terikelowi : nwi(4)ye : tedḫelowi : apote : (5)yi[.]rbose : yetmke[.]owi : (6)mdo?l? : ẖnbelile : se mlowi : a(7)t : mẖe : psi?ḫ?r?kete : a(8)t?mẖe : psiḫrke?te : ḫẖ?e?[.](9)s? : solkete : slomrse : (10)teñ?iy?[.]lowi
notes: Groups written slash-slash-3 (with a tailed 3) read q + o: compare Sh. 7 line 1 where the same group is followed by w i ('qowi'); 'sic' stands over the 3 of the final 'qosi' here, where Sh. 7 has 'qowi'. 'soreyi': a hole in the stone between e and y, no sign shown lost. The 'S + short 2' group (lines 2, 4) read k + e (k with a short tail), not a; the long-tailed 52 groups read a (apote, at). Pointed (Sigma-topped) long-tailed sign read p (psiḫ-, psol-), round-topped long-tailed 3 read k (-kete); this follows context, the hand key describes k as Sigma-topped. m against ẖ in 'mẖe' set by context (two 3-shaped signs). Line 6 first word: d? is an R-like sign with a hook (same as d in tedḫe), l? hatched. Line 6 'ẖnbelile': the 4 + small hook could be one sign. 'se' = J with two strokes. Line 9 start (ḫẖ?e?[.]): parallel to Sh. 7 line 8 'ḫẖeol'; the hatching may hold o + l. The '/3' groups in soreyi and solkete read s + o, though q is possible by shape. Line 10: hole in the stone before te, nothing marked lost; ñ? is a crossed sign (could be d); y? is two strokes partly under hatching.

caption: Sh. 7. Stela (Areika, Pl. 34, No. 5106)
reading: wosi soreyi : b?sysqo(2)wi : ksidye : ted(3)ḫelowi : sbre(4)ye : terikelo(5)wi : atmẖe : psi[.](6)ẖ?e?kete : atmẖe : (7)psiḫrkete : ḫ(8)ẖ?eol? : psolke(9)te siwi : teks?e(10)ñ? : siwiwil? : psi(11)ẖ?esk?[.]te
notes: No divider between wosi and soreyi. First sign of the name after soreyi (b?) is a hooked, lying sign, unsure. 'ksidye': first sign a round-topped 3 with a long tail (k or p). Line order: copy row 2 right to left holds line 3 marker over ḫ of tedḫe; line 5 marker stands over w of the lowi in copy row 3 left, line 4 marker over the y of 'sbreye' (copy row 3 right); Line 9 marker stands over te at the left end of copy row 5, no divider after it. Benedictions: 'at mẖe : psi...kete' twice; in the first the 3-shaped signs stand in the order 3-then-tailed 3, read mẖe by context. 'psi[.](6)ẖ?e?kete': one hatched sign after psi, then a tailed 3 and a reversed S (e?). Line 8: ḫ ends line 7; 'ẖ?eol?' unsure. Line 10/11: 'siwi', 'siwiwil?' read as written (43 = s i, 48 = w i); te-k?-s?-e then crossed sign ñ? (or d). Last word: hatched loop sign before te not readable.
